svg.title: CAP patch, adult member without grade
svg.metadata: {"asset_id":"rank-cap-patch-no-grade","name":"CAP patch, adult member without grade","size_in":{"w":1.5,"h":0.83},"units":"1 user unit = 0.01 in","viewBox":[0,0,150,83],"size_source":"estimated","size_basis":"CAPR 39-1 Fig A5-2, tile \"Adult member without grade pursuing officer grade\": 385 x 212 px against the 1.15 x 1.25 in Lt Col cloth patch in the same figure (295 x 319 px, 1 in leaf + 1/8 in border) = 256 px/in","provenance":"measured from CAPR 39-1 Fig A5-2; lettering is the sleeve CAP glyph set stretched to the measured word box","colours":{"cloth":"#142347","letters":"#f4f6f8"},"anchors":{"top_center":[75,0],"bottom_center":[75,83],"center":[75,41.5],"left_edge":[0,41.5],"right_edge":[150,41.5],"insignia_center":[75,41.5]},"dimensions":{"form":"cloth patch","patch_w_in":1.5,"patch_h_in":0.83,"word_w_in":1.22,"word_h_in":0.39},"mounts":[{"uniform":"ABU coat collar / OCP, ABU and tactical caps","rule":"worn where officers wear grade insignia by adults without grade pursuing officer promotion (CAPR 39-1 1.4.1, Fig A5-2)"},{"uniform":"OCP coat","rule":"senior members without grade wear the blank 2 x 2 in dark blue square instead (7.1.1.2.1): use rank-ocp-square-blank"}],"rank":{"grade":"none","membership":"senior"},"grade":"rank-insignia"}
